notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Screaming Nemesis.
description:
Deal damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis and Fiendlash trigger.
Resolve the Screaming Nemesis trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Fiendlash trigger, targeting you, but dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis instead due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.
